title: America’s Most Wanted implodes
summary: The partnership of Chris Harris and James Storm collapses into a bitter singles feud. A failed blindfold showdown leads to a violent Texas Death match.

chapters.title: The blindfold cage confrontation
chapters.result: James Storm defeats Chris Harris in a blindfold cage match.
chapters.context: The stipulation plays on Harris’ storyline eye injury and the resentment left by their team’s breakup. Harris still wants a conclusive fight.

chapters.title: Harris wins the Texas Death match
chapters.context: The former partners’ feud reaches its most physical payoff in a match built around pinfalls followed by ten-counts.
